data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-y-y', meaning 'to be gentle' or 'tender'. This name is often used to describe a delicate and kind-hearted person. The name Neeya carries the meaning “Gentle, Tender, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Neeya usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, tender, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
